title: activity inferred from the CLI's own transcript
asserts: a session whose CLI is appending records to its own stream-json transcript reads busy even though nothing painted a working footer, and the records a transcript already held when the core first read it do not pulse a session busy at all.

steps.note: the first activity broadcast can precede `created`; see the ambiguity notes
the CLI writes its first record; the only bytes on the pty are the echo of this command
a core that could not bind the transcript before the file existed backs off; this outlasts it
output is what makes a core read the transcript, so this is what gets the first records read
the file as it stood before the core was reading it is history: a resumed conversation's finished turns must not read as work in progress
a record the agent produced opens a turn with no footer anywhere on screen, and opening one never pings
the settle a record armed is the settle output arms: a quiet screen ends the turn and that is the edge a human is told about
